scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: Dahan Enheartened at Terror II or III gives each player Gather and Damage instructions in their chosen land. Players A and B each choose to Gather one Dahan. May A Gather, then B Gather, then both deal their Damage, or must one player finish that player's full instructions before the next begins?

After a primary action and all triggered actions finish, an Invader is still illegally placed. Do players check victory/defeat with that illegal position first, or correct its position before that check? Assume a legal destination exists.

Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold handled only as an ordinary effect when resolving that Innate, or applied before checking the phase in which the Innate can be used?

Bringer has used Vengeance of the Dead in a land. A later action by another Spirit actually destroys a Town there, causing Bringer's Vengeance to trigger. Is the triggered Damage real because the other Spirit caused the trigger, or does it still follow To Dream a Thousand Deaths?

A populated land matches both the Ravage card and the Build card this turn. A Spread of Rampant Green has three Presence in that land and uses Choke the Land with Green to skip its Ravage, destroying one of those Presence. No other effect changes the land before Build. Does that payment also skip the later Build, or must Green choose again and destroy another of its Presence there? Is the remaining Sacred Site sufficient for that second use?

A Ravage destroys a Dahan. Thunderspeaker has no Presence in the ravaged land but has its own Presence in an adjacent land. Can Sworn to Victory require destruction of that nearby Presence, or is the rule confined to Presence in the ravaged land?

The Trees and Stones Speak of War has created its per-Dahan Defend in a land also benefiting from Words of Warning's separate Defend 3. Trees and Stones meets its threshold and Pushes one Dahan out. Does that Dahan carry the separate Defend 3 too, or only its own Defend 2 from Trees and Stones?
A copy of the core game contains 14 Presence disks of one color. Should all 14 be used for that Spirit's setup and later Presence availability, or is one a spare?

In standard one-Spirit solo, are any of the eight original-core Spirits prohibited because their special restrictions appear to require teammates, including Ocean's Hungry Grasp or Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares?

A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?

When Green adds Presence via Growth, may it use destroyed disks while tracks still contain Presence? What is the price while Healthy versus Blighted? Does this special rule also let an ordinary Power Add Presence use destroyed disks?

Ocean has previously Drowned Invaders stored on its panel. Between actions in a later Spirit Phase, may it exchange them for Energy to help pay for cards that turn, or must it wait for another Drowning or the Gain Energy step?

Ocean chooses its Growth option with two “Add a Presence in any Ocean” instructions. May one disk be placed in the Ocean of a different island board where Ocean currently has no Presence, without measuring a numeric Range from its existing Presence?
When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?
Green chooses its Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group. Does it also perform the separate ALWAYS Add Presence to Jungle/Wetland, or must it choose between that addition and Reclaim?

Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?
A legally used Elemental Boon grants Elements through its effect text. It is then legally Repeated using Powerstorm. Does the Repeat grant the Elements specified by that effect text again?
Under The Urgency of War, is setting a limit on the time available to complete the Spirit Phase reserved for the game owner/organizer, or may any player set such a limit?

Bringer uses Spirits May Yet Dream to turn an unearned Fear Card in the Fear deck face-up. Does turning it face-up immediately earn that card or let players resolve its Fear effect now, or must it still be earned and resolved normally?
